title: Local structure and residue field of a coefficient subalgebra
statement: Let k be a field, Λ an Artinian local k-algebra with residue field K and maximal ideal m, σ:K→Λ a section of reduction, t a finite subset of m, and s a finite subset of K. Assume the image of k in Λ is contained in the subring generated by t and σ(k(s)). Then C_s of [def-weil-pbc-artinian-coefficient-subalgebra] is Artinian local, its maximal ideal is the contraction of m, and its residue field is isomorphic as a k-algebra to k(s). This conclusion requires no flatness, no enlargement of s, and no assumption that t spans all of m.

source.place: Tag 07FG, proof of lemma-helper, polynomial images and final presentation paragraph

proof.text: Set F=k(s), and equip Lambda with the F-algebra structure induced by the actual ring map sigma restricted to F. Set B=Algebra.adjoin F t and C=C_s. Their underlying subrings agree: both contain t and sigma(F), and the assumed coefficient containment puts the image of k inside the ring closure generated by these elements. This proves both inclusions by the universal property of ring closure.

The maximal ideal of the Artinian local ring Lambda is nilpotent, by Mathlib isArtinianRing_iff_isNilpotent_maximalIdeal (Noetherianness follows from Hopkins-Levitzki). Choose n with m^n=0. Nontriviality gives n>0. Each x in t has x^n=0, so IsIntegral.of_pow applied to isIntegral_zero proves it integral over F. Algebra.finite_adjoin_of_finite_of_isIntegral gives Module.Finite F B. Apply IsArtinianRing.of_finite F B, the recorded finite-dimensional-algebra result, then transport Artinianness along RingEquiv.subringCongr to C.

The inclusion C into Lambda reflects units: an ambient unit is a non-zero-divisor, injectivity of the inclusion makes the corresponding element of C a non-zero-divisor, and IsArtinianRing.isUnit_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors makes it a unit in C. Ambient locality therefore gives IsUnit x or IsUnit (1-x) in C, which proves locality by IsLocalRing.of_isUnit_or_isUnit_one_sub_self. Since units also map to units, membership in the two maximal ideals, expressed as nonunit membership, agrees, proving the contraction equality.

Induct on the k-algebra adjoin to show that ambient reduction of every element of C belongs to F: t reduces to zero, sigma(a) reduces to a by the section identity, and reduction respects k, addition and multiplication. Codomain restriction constructs a k-algebra map f:C -> F. It is surjective because sigma(a) belongs to C and reduces to a. The kernel is the maximal ideal of C by IsLocalRing.ker_eq_maximalIdeal. Compose Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq with Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective to obtain the required k-algebra equivalence from the residue field of C to F. No choice of algebraic data from an unproved theorem is used.

lean.statement:
theorem artinian_coefficient_subalgebra_structure
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (Λ : Type v) [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k Λ]
    [IsArtinianRing Λ] [IsLocalRing Λ]
    (σ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ →+* Λ) (t : Finset Λ)
    (s : Finset (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ))
    (hσ : (IsLocalRing.residue Λ).comp σ = RingHom.id _)
    (ht : (t : Set Λ) ⊆ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Λ)
    (hc : ∀ a : k, algebraMap k Λ a ∈ Subring.closure ((t : Set Λ) ∪
      σ '' (IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ)) :
        Set (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ)))) :
    ∃ hA : IsLocalRing (artinianCoefficientSubalgebra k Λ σ t s),
      IsArtinianRing (artinianCoefficientSubalgebra k Λ σ t s) ∧
      @IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (artinianCoefficientSubalgebra k Λ σ t s) _ hA =
        Ideal.comap (artinianCoefficientSubalgebra k Λ σ t s).val.toRingHom
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal Λ) ∧
      Nonempty (@IsLocalRing.ResidueField (artinianCoefficientSubalgebra k Λ σ t s) _ hA
        ≃ₐ[k] IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set (IsLocalRing.ResidueField Λ)))
